title: Treaty of Hopewell
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Hopewell", at revision 1379921118, opens: "Three agreements, each known as a Treaty of Hopewell, were signed between representatives of the Congress of the United States and the Cherokee, Choctaw, and Chickasaw peoples. They were negotiated and signed at the Hopewell plantation in South Carolina over 45 days during the winter of 1785–86." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7837100, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "three treaties between the U.S. and Native Americans signed at the South Carolina plantation". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
